description: This file manages plugin catalogs for channels in the openclaw project, including loading, parsing, and building catalog entries from various sources such as bundled, official, external, and discovered plugins. It also provides functions to generate UI catalog data and retrieve specific plugin entries.

methods.name: parseCatalogEntries
methods.description: Parses raw catalog data into an array of ExternalCatalogEntry objects.

methods.name: splitEnvPaths
methods.description: Splits environment variable string into an array of paths.

methods.name: resolveDefaultCatalogPaths
methods.description: Resolves default catalog file paths based on environment configuration.

methods.name: resolveExternalCatalogPaths
methods.description: Determines catalog paths from options, environment variables, or defaults.

methods.name: loadExternalCatalogEntries
methods.description: Loads catalog entries from external catalog files specified in options.

methods.name: loadCatalogEntriesFromPaths
methods.description: Reads and parses catalog entries from given file paths.

methods.name: resolveOfficialCatalogPaths
methods.description: Resolves paths to official catalog files based on package root locations.

methods.name: loadOfficialCatalogEntries
methods.description: Loads catalog entries from official catalog files.

methods.name: toChannelMeta
methods.description: Converts manifest channel data into a ChannelMeta object.

methods.name: resolveInstallInfo
methods.description: Determines installation info for a plugin from its manifest and context.

methods.name: resolveCatalogPluginId
methods.description: Resolves plugin ID from package or root directory.

methods.name: buildCatalogEntry
methods.description: Constructs a catalog entry from plugin candidate data.

methods.name: buildExternalCatalogEntry
methods.description: Builds a catalog entry from external catalog data.

methods.name: loadBundledMetadataCatalogEntries
methods.description: Loads catalog entries from bundled plugin directories.

methods.name: buildChannelUiCatalog
methods.description: Creates UI catalog data from plugin list.

methods.name: listChannelPluginCatalogEntries
methods.description: Lists all plugin catalog entries, combining discovered, bundled, official, and external sources with priority.

methods.name: getChannelPluginCatalogEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific plugin catalog entry by ID.
